text:
Gina P.: quick sync — drafting an "early adopter engagement" checklist for the new inference features. want 2 things: (1) recruitment filter we use to select partners, (2) 3 success metrics for go/no-go. thoughts?

Raj K.: love it. prioritize partners that already have production LLM usage + measurable latency/cost pain.

Maria S.: +1. also add security posture requirement: SOC2 or equivalent, or willingness to run in VPC. reduces scope for private-mode testing.

Sam L.: can we be explicit about what 'measurable' means? e.g., baseline p95 latency, token cost per request, and user-facing error rate. short and quantitative.

Tara (Growth): for incentives, t-shirt + $1k AWS credit rarely moves the needle. better: co-marketing (case study + webinar) and early pricing lock. also timeline clarity.

Gina P.: good. draft idea below for screening Qs — keep it 6 bullets so recruiting isn't a slog:
```
1) Do you run LLM inference in production today? (yes/no)
2) Typical request pattern: low-latency single-turn vs high-throughput batch? (choose)
3) Current avg p95 latency and tokens per request (ballpark)
4) Monthly inference spend (or range)
5) Data sensitivity: public / internal / regulated (e.g., PCI/PHI)
6) Willingness to set aside an engineering contact for 4-8 weeks? (yes/no)
```

Raj K.: compress question 3/4 into ranges to improve response rates. e.g., p95 <200ms, 200-500ms, >500ms; spend buckets <$2k, $2k-20k, >$20k.

Maria S.: for onboarding success criteria, propose: (A) instrumented integration within 2 weeks, (B) measurable >10% cost reduction or p95 drop >=25% on pilot route, (C) no regressions in output quality above agreed eval set.

Sam L.: add qualitative signal: partner reports NPS >=6/10 on integration experience and controls.

Tara (Growth): timeline suggestion: recruitment window 3 weeks, onboarding 2 weeks, 6-week pilot, 2-week analysis & decision = ~13 weeks total. Is that too long?

Gina P.: sounds fine. we should also define 'canary rollback' rules in launch criteria: automatic fallback to partner's existing endpoint if latency or error spikes exceed threshold. ops-bot, can you note a template for SLO thresholds?

ops-bot: SLO template attached: p95 latency target, error rate threshold, and gradual traffic ramp rules. see short link: https://intra.redwood/slo-template

Raj K.: for scope negotiation with partners: lock the pilot on 1 route, 1 model variant, up to X qps simulated. any broader scope requires new MOU.

Maria S.: add data handling addendum: logs & traces for debugging are ok if hashed/anonymized; raw data only with explicit consent.

Gina P.: next steps: I'll update the checklist and screening form, draft partner MOU, and circulate a short recruiter playbook. can each of you comment within 48h on the doc I'll link here? planning to start outreach week of 2026-04-06.

Sam L.: will review.

Tara (Growth): will prep outreach copy and partner value prop.

Raj K.: I'll draft the pilot success dashboard metrics and alerts.

Maria S.: will build onboarding runbook and quick troubleshooting checklist.

Gina P.: thanks — tagging folks for follow-up: @Raj K., @Maria S., @Sam L., @Tara (Growth). :sparkles:
